# Pixelette Certified

> UK-headquartered compliance consultancy. Certification readiness, cyber assurance, privacy and AI governance. Fixed-fee, scoped before work begins. Delivered across UK, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, EU, Americas, and APAC.

Pixelette Certified is a consultancy. It is not a certification body, it does not issue certificates, reports or attestations, and it holds no accreditation of its own. Where a framework requires independent certification, scheme assessment or attestation, that assessment is performed by the appropriate independent body.

Office: 66 Paul Street, London, EC2A 4NA. Contact: info@pixelettecertified.com.

## What We Do

We help organisations meet the security, privacy, AI-governance and assurance requirements standing between them and enterprise customers, tenders, investors and regulated markets. We manage the engagement from initial gap assessment through implementation, audit readiness and ongoing compliance, matching each requirement to the right credentialed specialists and coordinating independent assessment where required.

Core services: ISO/IEC 27001 implementation and certification readiness, ISO/IEC 42001 AI governance and certification readiness, SOC 2 Readiness, vCISO and GRC advisory, Privacy and vDPO, managed compliance, Cyber Essentials Readiness and Coordination, PCI DSS Readiness and Compliance Support, GDPR / UK GDPR programmes, and selected regional GRC frameworks (SAMA CSF, NCA ECC/CCC, QCB/NIA).

## Key Facts

- One accountable client relationship, with credentialed specialists matched to the requirement
- A written scope and a fixed fee agreed before any work begins. No hourly billing, no scope creep
- Internal audit run before the certification body's Stage 2, so findings surface internally first
- 90 days post-certification support included as standard
- Clear separation between implementation and independent assurance
- Our approved delivery network includes a PECB Certified ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor
- No completion date is promised before scope, current readiness and the independent assessment route have been confirmed

## What We Are Not

Pixelette Certified is not UKAS accredited, not an IASME Certification Body, not a PCI QSA, not a SOC 2 auditor, and not an ISO certification body. Professional credentials referenced on this site are held by the individual practitioners to whom they were issued and are stated as individual or network credentials, never as corporate accreditations.

## Services

- [ISO/IEC 27001 Implementation & Certification Readiness](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-27001): Information Security Management System. Gap assessment, ISMS implementation, policies, controls, risk treatment, internal readiness, and coordination of the independent certification route.
- [ISO/IEC 42001 AI Governance & Certification Readiness](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-42001): AI Management System design and implementation, AI risk and governance controls, EU AI Act aligned, readiness for an independent certification route.
- [ISO 22301 Business Continuity](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-22301): Business Continuity Management. Disaster recovery, crisis management, resilience.
- [ISO 9001 Quality Management](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-9001): Quality Management System. Widely required in enterprise procurement.
- [ISO 14001 Environmental Management](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-14001): Environmental Management System. ESG and sustainability obligations.
- [Cyber Essentials Readiness & Coordination](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/cyber-essentials): Readiness, remediation support, and portal or assessment coordination. The formal assessment is delivered through the appropriate authorised route.
- [vCISO & GRC Advisory](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/vciso): Fractional security leadership, governance, risk oversight and board reporting within an agreed scope.
- [Privacy & vDPO](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/vdpo): Privacy governance, DPIA support, RoPA oversight, and an externally delivered DPO service where appropriate.
- [GDPR & Privacy](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/gdpr-privacy): UK GDPR and EU GDPR compliance programmes.

## Evidence Policy

We do not publish client case studies, testimonials, certification counts, pass rates or average delivery times. Client work is confidential, and proof is published only where it can be substantiated and correctly attributed.
